sloka: अथवा विहितेनायं हन्यते हन्ति वा परम्।विधिरालिप्यते तेन न स पापेन कर्मणा ।। ६.८३.२३ ।।
transliteration: athavā vihitenāyaṁ hanyate hanti vā param।vidhirālipyate tena na sa pāpena karmaṇā ।। 6.83.23 ।।

translations.english: "Or else if a man is destroyed by killing another, destiny which is engendered by the sinful action suffers and not the doer of sinful action."
